Interface DistributedLock

All Known Implementing Classes:
RedisDistributedLock
public interface DistributedLock
A reentrant distributed mutex identified by name().

Unlock must be called by the same thread that acquired the lock. The Redis implementation stores an owner token, so a process cannot delete another holder's key.

    • tryLock

      boolean tryLock(long waitTime, long leaseTime, TimeUnit unit) throws InterruptedException
      Tries to acquire the lock, waiting up to waitTime and holding it for leaseTime.
      Parameters:
      waitTime - maximum time to wait for the lock; 0 means try once
      leaseTime - how long to hold the lock before it expires
      unit - time unit for both values
      Returns:
      true if this thread now holds the lock
      Throws:
      InterruptedException - if the current thread is interrupted while waiting

    • lock

      void lock()
      Acquires the lock, waiting as long as necessary, using the default lease time.
      Throws:

    • unlock

      void unlock()
      Releases one hold of the lock.
      Throws:
